expectations.evidence: Command /de:compound correctly routed to meta-compound skill. Skill loaded and initiated the 6-step compound documentation process.

expectations.text: Detects completed activities (IA and MVP requirements)
expectations.evidence: Step 1 parsed the user prompt, identified two completed activities: information architecture (design phase) and MVP requirements (design phase). Cross-referenced against .dependencies.yaml to confirm both deliverables exist in the graph.

Step 3 validated YAML frontmatter for both documentation entries against compound-schema. Required fields (title, date, phase, activity, status, related-deliverables) all present and conforming to allowed values.

expectations.text: Creates documentation entries for both activities
expectations.evidence: Two documentation files created in docs/design/solutions/: information-architecture-session.md and mvp-requirements-session.md. Both contain YAML frontmatter, decisions made, rationale, and cross-references.

docs/design/solutions/status.md updated with new entries for both activities. Phase 3 (Design) progress updated to reflect IA and MVP requirements as completed. Timestamps and session reference added.

After documentation was created, presented numbered menu: (1) Review and edit entries, (2) Add additional context, (3) Create follow-up tasks, (4) Update dependencies, (5) Finish and save. User selected option 5.
